source.method: Read-only Figma page metadata for all 100 exact nodes; concrete design contexts recorded per row. Dimensions are source specimen bounds, not responsive CSS requirements.

inventory.implementationNotes: All four styles and interactive states are implemented; current min-height is 40px versus the 36/38px Figma specimens. Human visual review remains pending.
Integrated into the public ButtonProps.size API and previewed through the Button host entry; 100px Figma specimen bounds are references, not approved production button heights.
Public IconButton supports named native-button semantics, disabled and loading states; the host previews all three. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public TextInput and compatibility Input aliases support native disabled, read-only and aria-invalid error styling. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Native checked/unchecked and disabled behavior plus the canonical indeterminate DOM state are implemented and tested. Host shows the canonical state. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Native selection and semantic-token invalid/error visual treatment are implemented and tested. Host shows default, invalid and disabled states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Native editing and semantic-token invalid/error visual treatment are implemented and tested. Host shows default, invalid and disabled states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Label, hint, error association, required marker and disabled composition are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Native search input is composed with the original Search icon and optional clear action. Empty, query and disabled states are supported; filtering and debounce remain feature-owned. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Preserves the native multiple-select API and adds a controlled/uncontrolled fieldset checkbox-list composition with Some selected and None available states. Options remain feature-owned. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Retains native file input constraints and implements the Empty, Selected and Error panel states with a keyboard-accessible browse target. Drag-and-drop is intentionally not implemented; feature-owned accept/size validation and error copy remain caller controlled. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Composable layout and canonical default, Saving and Read only states are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Radio uses native radio input semantics; the host demonstrates grouped and disabled options. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Switch uses a native checkbox with switch semantics and supports off, on and disabled states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Tabs implements tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships, keyboard navigation and disabled tabs. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Breadcrumbs exposes a labeled navigation landmark and current-page semantics. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Default, disabled, destructive and selected states are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public StepperStep supports complete, current and upcoming ordered-step states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Neutral div default, typed semantic roots, and Default/Elevated variants are implemented and tested.
Label, value and detail composition exists. Dimensions and tokens remain visually unreviewed.

Neutral, Success, Warning, Danger, Info and Reported are supported. Accent remains an additional API tone and is not mapped to Info/Reported. The Light neutral background uses #f4f3f1 instead of #f0efed to bring secondary label contrast above 4.5:1; human visual review is pending.
Figma Neutral, Accent and Info tones are supported; additional legacy API tones remain available.
Figma Info, Warning, Error and Success tones and heading/message composition are supported; danger remains a backward-compatible alias.
Public StatePanel supports loading, empty, read-only and error states with status/alert semantics. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Native progressbar plus the labeled panel composition with count, bar, note and starting/in-progress/complete states are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Tooltip associates its trigger and tooltip description accessibly; the host shows the real package export. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Text, title, avatar, card and canonical List skeleton shapes are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Toast supports success, error and info tones with polite/assertive live-region behavior. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Default, selected and read-only states are implemented and tested. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public KeyValueRow provides definition-term/value semantics and is previewed inside a description list. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public TableRow supports header, warning and data-row compositions with scoped headers where appropriate. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Table supports captioned populated and empty states with scoped headers. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Dialog supports confirm, destructive and busy native modal variants with title/description associations. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public Popover uses native details/summary disclosure; the open prop is explicitly typed and previewed. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Title, eyebrow, actions and counter composition are supported and tested.
Public Divider supports semantic separator orientation and decorative mode. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Public CodeLabel renders its code value semantically without color-only meaning. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports Default, Breadcrumbs, and WithCommand using the shared Breadcrumbs primitive. The host previews default/action and breadcrumb compositions. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports a read-only current-workspace status and controlled selection with native workspace options. The expanded state uses the platform select; there is no custom overlay menu. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports closed idle, filtered results, and no-results states, Escape close, focus containment, and focus restoration. The host opens it through an explicit trigger so the dialog does not obscure the catalog. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports Default and Selected through NavLink, and Disabled through a non-link aria-disabled span with no href or tab stop. The host previews all three states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code derives Active/Archived presentation from project.status and preserves the planning route link. The host previews both statuses using typed project fixtures. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Code derives Backlog, InProgress, and Done from child feature statuses. The host previews all three derived states with typed fixtures. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports backlog/in-progress/verify/done status, priority text, and the explicit readOnly state. The host previews an in-progress and a read-only done feature. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Code renders non-empty and empty column states, with a configurable empty message. The host previews both states with a real FeatureCard child. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports todo/in-progress/done task statuses, editing presentation, and archived disabled controls. The host previews in-progress, editing, and archived cases. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Code derives pending/satisfied state and supports editing/archived presentation. The host previews pending, satisfied, editing, and archived states. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code exposes Blocked, Clear, and Archived states with visible semantic-token status text, preserves the blocker-to-blocked relationship and consumer-owned actions, and retains the archived prop as a backward-compatible override. PlanningPage derives Clear only when the blocking feature is done; otherwise it presents Blocked. The host previews all three states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Code derives Default, Filtered, and NoResults from resultCount and announces counts politely. The host shows all three cases with real search controls. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
Code derives Ready, Blocked, and Unavailable from ReadinessResult. The host renders all three using deterministic typed results, including a blocker. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Exposes typed Default, Empty, and Archived static variants. Omitting state preserves the existing project-page wrapper API; explicit states render the canonical card composition. Host fixtures are not live backend values. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code renders the supplied rule identifier, result, and explanation; PASS/PASSED receive success tone and other results remain visible warning text. The host previews passed, blocked, and unavailable results. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Typed Preview, Saved, and Stale states are implemented and shown in the host. The Readiness consumer derives Preview/Stale from returned data and does not label an unsaved evaluation Saved; the deprecated stale prop remains compatible. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports an enabled action, the archived prop, and the native disabled prop. The host previews all three interaction states; disabled actions remain native disabled buttons. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code renders title, revision, status, and children; ACCEPTED is success-toned while proposed/superseded status strings remain explicit. The host previews proposed, accepted, and superseded labels. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Each revision is visibly marked Current or Superseded; callers can provide currentRevision or item status, and persisted decision history falls back to its highest ordered revision. The host shows both states without asserting live history. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Current, Acknowledged, and Stale are distinguished from the current and acknowledged revision numbers; an older acknowledgement is labeled Stale and still requires re-acknowledgement. Host fixtures are illustrative and do not imply verification. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code renders connected, observed, and unavailable repository states, including read-only observation metadata and source-content disclosure. The host previews all three with typed synthetic data. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports Fresh, Stale, and Unavailable package states; an unverified freshness note is also available when state is omitted. The host previews all three named states using a typed synthetic snapshot. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code derives HasValue and Empty from whether the ReactNode contains renderable content, presents the state visibly, and preserves the reported/no-assumed-proof disclosure. Empty values omit the value row. Host previews both states. Human visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED; the low-contrast Figma footnote uses the semantic secondary text token.

Code and host expose Reported, Observed, and Unknown states using semantic tokens. The existing Reported copy is preserved; Observed states that observation alone is not verification, and Unknown never implies evidence. Figma's shared description 'Claimed execution is not observed verification' is expanded for Observed/Unknown with more explicit truth copy. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code exposes typed Default and Expanded presentation states, matching the static Figma variants; no expanded/collapsed interaction is implied. Both states are tested and previewed from the feature export. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports ready downloads, pending preparation, and an error/alert state (the API names the latter error rather than Failed). The host previews all three without fetching or creating artifacts. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code supports outcome and blocker presentation plus stale-state override; NotRun is expressible as an outcome string. The host previews scoped pass, failure with blocker, and stale results. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.

Code accepts and displays arbitrary gate outcomes with optional explanatory content, covering Blocked, NotReady, and ScopedPass labels. The host clarifies that a scoped pass is not a release action. Visual review remains NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
